    Class TagDb

    Tag database for managing tag definitions. Provides fast lookup by name, ID, or group. Used by ExifTool for tag normalization and validation.

    Example

    import { TagDb } from 'exiftool-ts';

    const db = new TagDb();
    db.register({
      id: 'CustomTag',
      name: 'CustomTag',
      description: 'My custom tag',
      format: 'string',
      writable: true,
      groups: { family0: 'Custom', family1: 'Custom', family2: 'User' },
    });
